resolution: Built the seeded nug example end to end: scripts/nug-gen.js (v8cli, no node) ports the trichome site's exact DNA/placement/SDF math, evaluates the body+leaf distance field on an 88^3 grid, extracts a mesh with surface nets, bakes per-vertex albedo (AO crevice shading, frost wash+grain, purple anthocyanin noise, amber pistil flecks at pistil anchors instead of hair geometry), and writes real editor model packages (manifest.json + OBJ + preview.png) under cart/editor/data/models/props/nug_<seed>/ for four seeds matching the site's own outputs. OBJ v-lines carry vertex colors that today's Zig loader harmlessly ignores. Same seed = same nug forever; ~2.5s and 27-43k tris per seed. Jar-volume-fill in the editor workspace is the agreed next step if the look is approved.
